chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played both copies of Water's Edge, then All Streams Flow to the Sea, all targeting Seapunk. With 8 Charge, the last card deals 13 damage, for 25 total and lethal.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea, which would gain 3 Block but deal only 21 damage and leave Seapunk at 1 HP.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 3 Block and Pyro application from Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi in exchange for securing lethal this turn.
q4_different_intent: No. Because the chosen line defeats Seapunk immediately with the printed board state, a different intent would not have changed it.
